recipe.variant: the downscale-after pattern: RealESRGAN_x4plus 4x then ImageScaleBy 0.5 (lanczos) = a 2x result with the GAN noise averaged out - the template's 'upscale 4x first, then resize down' tip
recipe.from_template: utility-gan_upscaler note (verbatim: 'Tip: Upscale 4x first, then use a resize node to bring it down to your target resolution') + hiresfix_esrgan_workflow (ImageUpscaleWithModel -> ImageScale downscale). ImageScaleBy keeps the aspect ratio; the archived example used ImageScale to a fixed size with bilinear.

downscale_method.note: lanczos (2026 templates; node tooltip: 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling) | area | bicubic | bilinear (archived example)

image.note: the still; output = input x 4 x downscale (2x by default)

recipe.defaults_note: 4x model, then x0.5 lanczos. Use this instead of a 2x model when the 4x model is the better one for the content; for an exact target size use ImageScale (width/height, 0 = keep aspect) in place of ImageScaleBy.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no official VRAM table; ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles internally at 512 px / 32 overlap and halves the tile on OOM down to 128 px, so any CUDA GPU runs it; speed, not VRAM, is the limit)
